name: ART 3650
title: Sculpture: Mold Making and Casting
description: Investigation of sculptural mold making and casting principles, techniques, and processes. The course covers rigid and flexible mold making for casting in a variety of materials, emphasizing technical skill, formal design, and conceptual invention using cast forms for the creation of mixed media sculpture and installation art. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: ART 2610; open only to Art majors, others by instructor consent.
